Brad has replied with the common available slot. I should now book the meeting.

The slot is Thursday, November 19 at 14:30.

My plan for this session is:
1.  Create the booking for Thursday at 14:30.
2.  Append a message to the workspace to inform Brad that the booking has been made, so he can send the confirmation email.
3.  End my session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
